title: A failed instance need not stop the service.
summary: A failed primary is identified, traffic shifts to a healthy replica, and the customer route recovers. An illustrative failover pattern, not a live operational runbook.

cues.title: The primary stops responding
cues.text: Customer requests cannot rely on this instance.

cues.title: Isolate the failed instance
cues.text: The unhealthy primary stays out of the serving route.

cues.title: Redirect to the healthy replica
cues.text: The route changes while the application endpoint stays the same.

cues.title: Check the new serving route
cues.text: Verify the replica before declaring recovery.

cues.title: Requests flow again
cues.text: Resilience comes from an alternate path, not a healthier-looking status label.
